description: This PHP source file defines the UpgraderController class within the OrangeHRM project. It extends an abstract controller and implements the preRender method to initialize the upgrade process screen in the HRM system's installation upgrade process.

classes.name: UpgraderController
classes.description: Handles the upgrade process UI by rendering the upgrade screen component during the pre-render phase in the OrangeHRM installer upgrade flow.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Initializes the upgrade process screen component and sets the current screen state for the upgrade process.
